note: Scripture source: Kulish 1905 (PD), from the ebible mirror's USFM (bibles/ukr_pan) via scripts/bible_mirror.py, all 66 books; Kulish's inner mark ‟ normalised to “. Translators looked up every quotation (cited or not) in that verse file and copied the bytes by script.

Derived by measurement: a row is mined only when the translator reported the quotation verbatim AND the chapter contains a 30-character run of that verse (or a quoted span of 10+ characters that is a substring of it or a neighbouring verse), compared with quotation marks and punctuation stripped. Translator-reported self/adapted renderings, and 27 verbatim claims that failed the check (mostly one-word echoes such as «вічний»), are self_rendered. 591 of 648 rows mined.

Where Torrey argues from the English Revised Version's wording, which Kulish does not carry, the R. V. sense is rendered and marked «за англійським Переглянутим перекладом» (Isa 53:10 in ch09 «за Американським стандартним перекладом», since Torrey quotes the ASV there). Where Kulish agrees, R. V. is dropped.

Kulish numbering differs from the AV in places the translators met: Gen 3 (one behind), 2 Cor 13:14 (Kulish 13:13), Phil 3:21 (Kulish 3:20), Ps 24:10 (inside Kulish 24:9), Lev 6 (Kulish 5:25ff). The author's printed citation is kept and the Kulish verse quoted.

English defects found while translating (wrong citations, OCR slips) are rendered in the corrected sense; the English repair ships with the ko edition (#7664), which owns this slug's BODY_CORRECTIONS. Citations printed as the author gave them by ruling: Rev 5:8-12, Col 1:22, (V. I).
